n0e52423fbc.headline: The dollar price in Luanda has not changed for more than a month
n0e52423fbc.summary: In Luanda, Angola, the dollar exchange rate has not changed for more than a month despite active currency trading by local 'kinguilas'.
n0e52423fbc.why: Stable dollar pricing in Angola affects import costs, inflation, and foreign exchange market dynamics in an oil-dependent economy.

n49a48fcdf0.headline: Where Vladislav Li got the money to buy BCC shares
n49a48fcdf0.summary: Banker Vladislav Li explained the source of funds for his purchase of shares in BCC, according to a meeting with journalists. The report gives no further details of the transaction.
n49a48fcdf0.why: BCC (Bank CenterCredit) is one of Kazakhstan's major commercial banks, so changes in its ownership can affect corporate governance and investor sentiment.

n968d16f5d4.headline: Angola puts more money into circulation in February
n968d16f5d4.summary: Preliminary data indicates Angola's broad monetary base expanded in January, with further increases expected in February.
n968d16f5d4.why: Money supply changes influence inflation and currency stability, affecting Angola's macroeconomic outlook.
